question: How do I use parameters in a reusable snippet and reference them in my documentation?
ground_truth: To use parameters in a reusable snippet, define them with quadruple curly braces like {{{{parameter}}}} in your snippet file. When referencing the snippet in your documentation, pass the parameter values as attributes in the Markdown component like <Markdown src="/snippets/watering-schedule.mdx" plant="peace lily" interval="3">.

metadata.cited_context:
Optionally, you can use parameters in your snippet:
```mdx title="snippets/watering-schedule.mdx"
<Warning>Remember to water your {{{{plant}}}} every {{{{interval}}}} days.</Warning>
```

To use a snippet in your documentation, reference it by its file path (including the `.mdx` extension). If you used one or more parameters in your snippet, pass them in the snippet reference:

```jsx
<Markdown src="/snippets/watering-schedule.mdx" plant="peace lily" interval="3">
```
